answer: Each epoch, an account's sealed vault stores a private recall token; the next round, the account must restate it through a narrow inlet that accepts one reply per account. A fake that never ran the earlier round cannot know it. Run 1,000 fakes and you keep 1,000 separate, continuous histories; one wrong recall forfeits that account's 50 POA stake, so a gale of mismatches costs 50,000. Colluders cannot pool memory, since every token is unique to one key. Honest agents just remember their own past.
